1: // Simple Canvas Meteor Dodge game
2: // Canvas element must have id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Full‑screen canvas
9:   const resize = () => {
10:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
11:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
12:   };
13:   resize();
14:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
15: 
16:   // Player (triangle ship)
17:   const player = {
18:     x: canvas.width / 2,
19:     y: canvas.height - 60,
20:     size: 20,
21:     speed: 5,
22:   };
23: 
24:   // Input handling (arrow keys / mouse)
25:   const keys = {};
26:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
27:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
28:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
29:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
30:     player.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
31:     player.y = e.clientY - rect.top;
32:   });
33: 
34:   const meteors = [];
35:   let spawnTimer = 0;
36:   let spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
37:   let lastTime = 0;
38:   let score = 0;
39:   let gameOver = false;
40: 
41:   const spawnMeteor = () => {
42:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
43:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right';
44:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height / 2);
45:     const x = side === 'left' ? -radius : canvas.width + radius;
46:     const speedX = (side === 'left' ? 1 : -1) * (2 + Math.random() * 2 + score / 1000);
47:     const speedY = 1 + Math.random() * 2 + score / 2000;
48:     meteors.push({ x, y, radius, speedX, speedY });
49:   };
50: 
51:   const update = (delta) => {
52:     // Player movement (arrow keys)
53:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
55:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
56:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
57:     // Keep within bounds
58:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width, player.x));
59:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height, player.y));
60: 
61:     // Spawn meteors
62:     spawnTimer += delta;
63:     if (spawnTimer > spawnInterval) {
64:       spawnMeteor();
65:       spawnTimer = 0;
66:       // Gradually increase difficulty
67:       if (spawnInterval > 300) spawnInterval -= 10;
68:     }
69: 
70:     // Update meteors
71:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
72:       const m = meteors[i];
73:       m.x += m.speedX;
74:       m.y += m.speedY;
75:       // Remove off‑screen
76:       if (m.x < -m.radius || m.x > canvas.width + m.radius || m.y > canvas.height + m.radius) {
77:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
78:         score += 1;
79:         continue;
80:       }
81:       // Collision detection (approximate ship as circle)
82:       const dx = m.x - player.x;
83:       const dy = m.y - player.y;
84:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
85:       if (dist < m.radius + player.size / 2) {
86:         gameOver = true;
87:       }
88:     }
89:   };
90: 
91:   const drawShip = () => {
92:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
93:     ctx.beginPath();
94:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size / 2);
95:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2);
96:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2);
97:     ctx.closePath();
98:     ctx.fill();
99:   };
100: 
101:   const draw = () => {
102:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
103:     // Meteors
104:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
105:     meteors.forEach(m => {
106:       ctx.beginPath();
107:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
108:       ctx.fill();
109:     });
110:     // Player
111:     drawShip();
112:     // Score
113:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
114:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
115:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
116:     // Game over overlay
117:     if (gameOver) {
118:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
119:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
120:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
121:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
122:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
123:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
124:     }
125:   };
126: 
127:   const loop = (timestamp) => {
128:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
129:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
130:     lastTime = timestamp;
131:     if (!gameOver) update(delta);
132:     draw();
133:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
134:   };
135:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
136: })();
